description: Optional WebGPU features requested when the adapter offers them. Order is contract: float32-filterable, then timestamp-query (#1007 always-on when available), then subgroups. The pre-standard chromium-experimental-subgroups fallback was dropped: every Chromium that ships WebGPU subgroups exposes the standard name. Mirrors collectOptionalDeviceFeatures() and wasm_renderer/device.cpp.

tsOnly.note: Capability tier 2 (#1512): requested after the three shared features, by the TS renderer only (the WASM backend is frozen, docs/WASM_BACKEND_POLICY.md). Each is optional and recorded on window.webgpuProbe. shader-f16 enables the `// @requires f16` variant path (wgslF16.ts); bgra8unorm-storage the direct-to-swapchain present (canvas_configure.json optIn.storageBinding); float32-blendable and dual-source-blending are recorded for a fixed-function compositor path (the shipped compositor is compute and needs neither); core-features-and-limits upgrades an adapter from the compatibility rung to a core device when it can.
